root_cause_label: Binary PDF Read Caused Runtime Crash at Step 1
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent's first and only action was to attempt reading a binary PDF with a text-based read tool, which triggered a runtime crash and immediately ended the trajectory with no further progress.
t_err_evidence: Step 1: agent issues '[read] /app/paper.pdf' — uses a raw text-read tool on a binary PDF file instead of a proper PDF-extraction approach (e.g., PyPDF2).
t_commit_evidence: After the single action the runtime crashed; with no remaining steps the failing outcome is locked in at step 1.
t_surface_evidence: Step 1 terminal output: 'The action has not been executed due to a runtime error. The runtime system may have crashed and restarted due to resource constraints.'
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked the awareness that a binary PDF cannot be read with a generic text-based read tool and that a dedicated library (e.g., PyPDF2) is required; this knowledge gap led it to pick the wrong tool on its very first action.
